subject: POC environment mutual plan & security handoff — next steps and deliverables
body_preview: Confirming MAP milestones and security handoff: API keys, org seed, IP allowlist, VPC peering; attaching the proposed MAP spreadsheet and network diagram.
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Morales <daniel@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: POC environment mutual plan & security handoff — next steps and deliverables

Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great questions from your infra and security teams. Per our conversation, I put together a concise mutual action plan with the core items we need to unblock the POC environment. Quick summary below and attached as GW_MAP_v1.xlsx so your engineers can comment directly.

Key deliverables & owners (target schedule in spreadsheet):
- Redwood: provision trial tenant + org seed; create service account and scoped API key (ETA: 2 business days after signed MSA)
- GreenWave: provide IP allowlist ranges and a service account email for peering auth (ETA: within 3 business days)
- Both: VPC peering coordination call to exchange routes and set up peering (schedule in sheet)
- Security evidence: we can provide SOC2 summary and network diagram; please list any additional attestations needed

Attachments: GW_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), redwood_network_diagram.pdf (high-level), service-account-template.txt (example service account + IAM roles)

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the MAP and fill in the IP ranges and primary infra contact in column C.
2) We schedule a 30-min peering + service-account call (I can host) — propose Thu 20 Mar 10:00-10:30 PT or Fri 21 Mar 09:00-09:30 PT.
3) Once IP ranges + account are confirmed we’ll issue the ephemeral API key and seed your org with the test tenant.

If that works I’ll send an invite with the draft agenda.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

---
Attachment: GW_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: redwood_network_diagram.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: service-account-template.txt (text/plain)
From: Daniel Morales <daniel@greenwavehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenwavehealth.com
Date: Wed, 19 Mar 2025 09:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC environment mutual plan & security handoff — next steps and deliverables

Ben — thanks for the fast follow. The MAP looks good at a glance. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- IP ranges: our infra team will provide both the public egress ranges and internal CIDR we'll use for peering. Expect that list by EOD Thu 20 Mar.
- Service account: can you confirm the minimum IAM roles you need? We want to lock down scope before we hand over accounts.
- Compliance: SOC2 summary is fine; procurement may ask for encryption-in-transit confirmation and CSP endpoint IPs for allowlisting.

We can do the peering sync on Thu 20 Mar at 10:00 PT — that slot works. Please send an invite and a short agenda.

Also copying procurement to flag that we will want the MSA countersigned before long — procurement@greenwavehealth.com can follow up on that.

Best,
Daniel Morales
Director, Infrastructure
GreenWave Health
daniel@greenwavehealth.com

---
"On Tue, Mar 18, 2025 at 4:04 PM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:"
> Hi Daniel,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday ...
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Mar 2025 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC environment mutual plan & security handoff — internal: assets to send

Thanks — looping in a couple items before the call.

Ben, I updated the network diagram with the proposed CIDR mapping for peering (attached redwood_network_diagram.pdf v2). Also added a short note in the MAP (GW_MAP_v1.xlsx) under "security artifacts" listing the SOC2 summary, TLS certs we present on endpoints, and the encryption-at-rest statement.

Neha — can you confirm the smallest set of IAM roles we should request for the GreenWave service account so we can include that in the invite? My recommendation (min set):
- read-only access to tenant metadata (to scope usage metrics)
- token exchange permission for the test service account (limited to test environment)

If procurement asks for a signed data processing addendum we have a template ready — I’ll attach to the invite if needed.

I also drafted a 15-min agenda:
- Introductions + responsibilities (3m)
- IP ranges + peering endpoints (5m)
- Service account role scope (4m)
- Next steps & timing (3m)

Ben, I left the Thu 20 Mar 10:00 PT slot open on my calendar.

Grace
Grace O'Connor | Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

---
Attachment: redwood_network_diagram_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Morales <daniel@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, procurement@greenwavehealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC environment mutual plan & security handoff — meeting invite + MAP v1 (finalized)

Daniel — confirmed for Thu 20 Mar 10:00 PT (we ended up doing a quick sync yesterday; forwarding final artifacts).

Attached: GW_MAP_v1.xlsx (final, please comment in-sheet), redwood_network_diagram_v2.pdf, service-account-template.txt

Quick notes for procurement and your infra lead:
- API key issuance: Redwood will create an API key tied to the test service account; key TTL = 7 days by default for trial, can be extended after acceptance testing.
- IP allowlist: we need both the public egress and the internal CIDR for peering. If you want to restrict to specific endpoint IPs we can provide a short list.
- VPC peering: we will request route exchange and confirm no overlapping CIDRs. If overlap exists, we will propose NAT-based routing for the POC.

Please review the MAP and let us know any edits. Once we have the IP list and the service-account email we will seed the org and hand over the key.

Thanks,
Ben
